rows.en: What about you? Do you... like me?

I-I...
The way I feel about you, Senpai, is...
rows.notes: Male only. Deliberately cut off before the confession.

rows.en: Just kidding!
Wha-a-a??

Ahahahahaha!
Hey, were you surprised?
Hey, hey!?
Surprised? More like that was just cruel...
Hehehe, sorry, sorry!

But you know, there are women out there
who'll toy with you like this, so you need
to keep your guard up, okay?
(Isn't she t-talking about herself...?)

Besides, you're my very own junior,
so no wandering off, got it!?
rows.notes: Male only. Kouhai-kun: 'my very own junior'.

rows.en: Mm, good answer.
rows.notes: Male only. Reacts to a reply not in the text.

rows.en: Well then, shall we call it a day and go home?
(I wonder how much of that Senpai meant...)

(I got to spend another fun day
with Claire-senpai.)
I'm glad to hear you say that.
(That might have been a close one...)

Not as my underclassman,
but as a girl.
Um, w-well, I...
Huh?

Hehe, someday you'll get to fluster
the boys like this too, okay?
(I don't know if I could ever pull that off...)
(I wonder how much of that Senpai meant...)

(I'm out with Senpai,
but what should we do after this?)

Hey, why don't we stop by Griffith Park
again today?

Sounds good.
It's my "special spot" too, after all.

Hehehe, it makes me really happy
to hear you say that.
The breeze feels nice, doesn't it...
Can we stay like this for a while?
Well then, let's head home.
I'll walk you home.
Thank you, as always.
(I hope days like this go on forever.)

Sounds good.
It's my "special spot" too, after all.
Can I walk home with you?
Of course.
(I hope days like this go on forever.)

(We arrived on a new planet
and started a new life.)

(I've been running nonstop, swept along
by how busy life was, but she was
always there by my side.)
rows.notes: Both endings (frd_cla_009 male, frd_cla_010 female); 'she' = Claire.

rows.en:
(She never gave up on someone like me
and always supported me.)

Come on!
Wake uuup!!
How long are you gonna sleep!!!

Mmm, mm~
Claire, five more minutes...

How many 'five more minutes' is that now...?
Breakfast is getting cold, so get. up. now!!

You start at your new job today, right?
Pull yourself together!!
Yeah, I'm coming, Claire.
(From now on, together forever.)

(I want to spend the rest of my life
with Claire.)
